observations: Photo 0 shows a beige sewing machine mounted in a cabinet/table base.
The word "SINGER" is visible embossed on the machine body in photo 0.
No power cord, plug, foot pedal, or electric motor is visible in the photo.
No light bulb or lamp housing is visible on the machine head.
Watermark text 'POSTED ON JIJI' and a name overlay the image, not seller-applied specs.

claims.evidence: No power cord, plug, or motor visible in photo 0 to confirm electric operation.
No lamp housing or bulb visible on the machine head in photo 0.

risks.risk: Machine may actually be a manual/treadle-converted unit rather than true electric, despite seller's claim.
risks.proof: A photo or short video showing the power cord plugged in and the machine running, plus a clear shot of the motor under the cabinet.
risks.if_unproven: priced as manual-only (no working electric motor)

risks.risk: Light bulb/lamp assembly may be missing or non-functional.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the lamp housing and bulb, ideally lit.

risks.risk: Internal mechanism (belt, bobbin, tension assembly) condition unknown; could have wear, rust, or missing parts not visible externally.
risks.proof: A video of the machine stitching a few lines on fabric.
risks.if_unproven: priced as not confirmed working, worst-case non-functional

risks.risk: Cabinet/table and foot pedal (if treadle-style) integrity and completeness not fully shown.
risks.proof: A wider photo showing the full cabinet, pedal, and underside wiring.
risks.if_unproven: priced as table/cabinet condition unverified, assume cosmetic wear only

proof_requests: Video of the machine plugged in and running with the light bulb lit.
Close-up of the model/serial plate for exact model identification.
Photo of the underside/motor area showing wiring and belt condition.
Short clip of the machine actually stitching fabric.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a Singer sewing machine by the visible brand mark, but electric operation and the light bulb claim are unverifiable from the photo, so it must be priced at worst case as a manual, non-illuminated unit pending proof.
